name: Riviera Tower
docs_listed: building permit issued August 2022 (date only, no number)
44th floor reached March 2026, triggering a c. EUR 60m contractual payment (Lamda annual report 2025)
50th floor and full 200 m height reached (Q1 2026 results call, July 2026)
architect Foster + Partners with Tombazis; engineer Buro Happold; contractor Bouygues Batiment International / AKTOR JV
note: 50-storey, 200 m residential tower at The Ellinikon by Athens-listed Lamda Development; the frame topped out in mid-2026, works have moved to MEP and interiors and Lamda targets handover to owners in summer 2027. All roughly 170 apartments were pre-sold (press reports 170 to 173 units, average about EUR 3.66m and EUR 14,000/m2 per Axia data), so there is no primary stock left. No permit number or deposit protection is published. (checked 1 Nov 2026)

seed.title: freehold
seed.developer_delivered: Lamda Development (listed on Athens Exchange) operates four completed malls including The Mall Athens, Golden Hall and Mediterranean Cosmos plus Flisvos Marina, per its 2025 annual report; no residential handovers at Ellinikon yet

evidence.permit: Press reports the building permit was issued in August 2022 after a multi-ministry approval, but no permit number is published by Lamda or the press
evidence.escrow: No escrow, bank guarantee or deposit protection published; Greece has no mandatory off-plan escrow and none is stated
evidence.progress: Dated milestones published by Lamda in audited annual report and results calls: foundations Oct 2023, 44th floor Mar 2026, 50th floor / 200 m mid-2026; a portal summary of the H1 2026 call quotes about 70% complete
evidence.plans: No floor plans found for the tower; units are sold out and marketed only through press
evidence.record: Lamda is listed on the Athens Exchange with audited accounts; it has built and operates several malls and marinas, though Ellinikon homes will be its first large residential deliveries
evidence.returns: No rental or guaranteed-return language; units were sold to owner buyers

claims.claim: 44th floor milestone in March 2026 triggered a c. EUR 60m contractual payment
All apartments sold out before construction
Average price about EUR 3.66m per unit and EUR 14,036/m2 (Axia data, 171 units, EUR 626m)
Contractor Bouygues Batiment International / AKTOR JV, design Foster + Partners
Developer is a listed company with audited accounts
Building costs rose after units were sold, margin below target (developer risk, not buyer)
Contractor page earlier showed 2026 delivery, now summer or end 2027

facts.listed_or_audited: Listed on Athens Exchange; audited annual report 2025 published
facts.foreign_ownership: Freehold title open to foreigners in Greece; about 40% of Ellinikon homes sold to foreigners per Lamda
facts.permit_authority: Hellenic Ministry of Environment and Energy / urban planning services (special Ellinikon framework)

positives: Developer is an Athens-listed company with audited accounts
Dated construction milestones reported in filings and results calls
Frame complete at 200 m, interiors under way
Named top-tier contractor, architect and engineer
